records.name: Brink

records.name: Dots by OpenAI

records.name: Semitexa

A project graph lets you (or your AI agent) query routes, dependencies and blast radius before editing. Pages render on the server and arrive in stages, with deferred blocks and live SSE updates and no second frontend. ORM, tenancy and queues are built in, and traces plus targeted tests verify every change. Explore 81 live demo routes, with the source next to each one.

records.name: Omnia Agent
records.tagline: The AI Agent that does 95% of your GEO work
records.description: Every brand needs to show up in AI search. Now yours can, without hiring a GEO expert. Omnia Agent finds the prompts where your competitors are winning, then wins them for you with skills built for GEO. It plugs into the tools you already use, so every action you approve goes live with no extra work.

records.name: ShareCube
records.tagline: Share what your agents make, get feedback on the exact line
records.description: ShareCube gives your AI agents a place to publish. From Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or any MCP client, your agent posts an HTML or Markdown artifact to a project and hands you a link, not a wall of chat. Your team comments on the exact sentence, @mentions each other and resolves threads. The agent reads that feedback and ships the next version. Every save is versioned. Share privately, with your org, or publicly: anyone with the link can read it, no account needed.

records.name: rhun
records.tagline: A small, fast code editor written in assembly

records.name: Vitra.ai

Brand kits, translation memory, & style guides keep every output on-brand. The future of Autonomous Content Operations is here Start free, no credit card.

records.name: Kholo

Work through English stories at your own level. Build something from parts your local shop sells. Ages 6–14, mapped to the NCERT syllabus.

records.name: Twin

records.name: Starlie

records.name: Stardrift for iOS

records.name: Helo

records.description: PrintProfit helps 3D printing sellers calculate accurate production costs and profitable selling prices. Estimate filament expenses, electricity costs, margins, and pricing in seconds through a simple web dashboard. Built for makers, Etsy sellers, print farms, and hobbyists who want to stop guessing and start pricing with confidence. Created using Replit and designed to make running a 3D printing business easier.

records.name: Green Screen Remover
records.tagline: Remove green backgrounds for free, without uploading
records.description: Remove green backgrounds directly in your browser. Fine-tune edges and green spill, then download a transparent PNG. Free, no login, no uploads, and no watermark. Your images stay on your device.

records.name: ApiMsg
records.tagline: Enterprise WhatsApp API, Automation & AI Agents
records.description: ApiMsg is an all-in-one WhatsApp Business API platform built for modern businesses. Effortlessly run high-converting broadcast campaigns, build no-code automation workflows, deploy 24/7 AI customer support agents, and collaborate in a shared team inbox. With ultra-fast Meta Cloud API integration and developer-friendly webhooks, ApiMsg turns WhatsApp into your #1 revenue and support engine.

records.name: AppApex
records.tagline: Your iOS app's growth metrics, finally talking to each other
records.description: Growing an iOS subscription app means living in a dozen tabs: App Store Connect, RevenueCat, Superwall, a keyword tracker, a review monitor, three ad dashboards and a spreadsheet gluing it together. None of them talk to each other. AppApex puts it all under one roof: downloads, revenue, trials, keyword ranks, reviews, competitors, paywalls and ad spend on one live dataset. So a keyword drop and a churn spike read as one story, not two alerts in two tabs, and you're told what to fix first.

records.name: HumHunt
records.tagline: Find a song by simply humming the tune
records.description: Search is mostly built for words. Our memory for music often isn't. We remember how a song goes long after we've forgotten what it's called. Shazam is great when the song is playing, but a wobbly, off-key hum from memory is a much harder problem. So I built humhunt. Hum it, whistle it or sing it into your mic, and it hunts down the song. You get a top match, a ranked list of other likely songs and a short preview of each so you can check. If a scrap of lyric comes back to you, type that in too.

records.name: AiKreyol
records.tagline: AI in Haitian Creole
records.description: AiKreyol is an AI platform built for Haitian Creole speakers worldwide. Ask questions, learn new skills, create content, generate images and videos, build websites, and get work done—all in natural Haitian Creole. We’re making powerful AI tools more accessible to Haitians by letting people use AI in the language they know best.

records.name: The Toolshed — Everyday Tools
records.tagline: daily tools(QR code/PW generator, GPA calc) for everyone
records.description: Mortgage, car loan, tip, BMI, age and date calculators, a QR code generator, a unit converter, and a password generator — one plain place for the everyday tools every generation reaches for. No accounts, nothing tracked.

records.name: Caliptic Translate — Real
records.tagline: Understand any podcast, video or meeting — 22 languages
records.description: Caliptic Translate does two things at once, in 22 languages. Everything your speakers play — podcasts, videos, news, lectures, meetings — becomes live translated subtitles and speech. And everything you say is translated and delivered to the other side as you speak. On a phone, two people can share one pair of earbuds: one language in each ear. It all runs on your own computer — no credits, no quotas, no per-minute billing. macOS, Windows and Android; iPhone in review.

records.name: Timer CLI Application
records.tagline: Light command-line utility that tracks active vs idle time
records.description: Timer CLI is a lightweight command-line utility designed for Linux systems that tracks the amount of active usage time versus idle time. It automatically pauses the active timer when no keyboard, mouse, or touch input is detected for a defined duration (default: 30 seconds; change the IDLE_LIMIT constant to adjust).

records.name: TripSynk
records.tagline: Group trips, minus the money confusion.
records.description: Trips are fun. Keeping track of payments, expenses and photos? Not so much. Meet TripSynk one place for your plans, money and memories. With TripSynk, you can: • Create trips and invite friends • Plan your itinerary together • Split and track expenses easily • Share photos and chat with your group • Track one-to-one expenses anytime Trip organizers can also use Host mode for client leads, payments and margin visibility.

records.name: Local Business Directory
records.tagline: Find a trusted local business near you
records.description: Verified businesses in Delhi-NCR. Browse 106 local businesses across 4 cities — phone numbers, addresses, opening hours…

records.name: ExamineIP - Lookalike Domain Checker
records.tagline: Spot lookalike letters in a link before you click it
records.description: A Cyrillic а looks exactly like a Latin a, so pаypal.com and paypal.com look identical but are different domains. Paste any link or domain to see what it is really made of: each character and its alphabet, the Punycode it actually resolves to (xn--pypal-4ve.com), and flags for mixed alphabets, invisible zero-width characters and right-to-left tricks. Runs entirely in your browser: no lookup, nothing sent, no signup. The detection library is open source (MIT).

records.name: Crypto payment gateway development
records.tagline: A flexible payment layer for the crypto economy
records.description: Our Crypto Payment Gateway Development solutions provide the infrastructure businesses need to accept and manage crypto payments across digital platforms. With wallet connectivity, transaction processing, blockchain integration, payment APIs, currency conversion, and merchant controls, the gateway creates a streamlined payment layer that can be customized around different business models and transaction requirements.

records.name: Vouch
records.tagline: Turn customer stories into powerful social proof
records.description: Vouch helps businesses collect authentic customer testimonials without the usual back-and-forth. Share a simple link with customers, let them record their experience, then manage and showcase those stories from one place. Turn real customer experiences into social proof you can use across your website, marketing, and sales.

records.name: Afromag
records.tagline: Free digital utilities and calculators for everyday creators
records.description: Afromag’s AMA Citation Generator is a lightning-fast, zero-dependency utility built for medical students, researchers, and health science professionals. Instantly format journal articles, books, and web sources into flawless 11th Edition American Medical Association references. Built strictly for speed and accuracy, this tool features no paywalls, no hidden subscriptions, and zero sign-ups. Generate and copy your citations to your clipboard in a single click.

records.name: Invora
records.tagline: Simple invoicing for freelancers and businesses.
records.description: Invora is a simple invoicing platform built for freelancers, businesses, and individuals who want to create and send professional invoices without the hassle. Create beautiful invoices, manage your clients, track payments, view your business activity, and keep everything organized in one place. Whether you're sending your first invoice or managing invoices for multiple clients, Invora keeps invoicing simple. Create. Send. Track. Get paid. And yes, Invora is free to use.

records.name: SwiftCard
records.tagline: Snap any business card and AI makes it yours
records.description: Give SwiftCard your headshot, logo and colors, or a photo of the card you already have, and AI designs your digital business card. Share it by QR, link, NFC or Apple Wallet, and people save you in one tap with no app. Behind the card: lead capture, automated email and text follow-ups, analytics on who viewed and saved you, a paper-card scanner, a link-in-bio page, a live email signature, CRM sync (HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, GoHighLevel) and team plans.

records.name: AI Data Analyst
records.tagline: AI data analyst that shows its work
records.description: Upload a spreadsheet, ask a question in plain English, get a verified answer — with the exact rows, filter, and formula behind it. Designed for accountants, e-commerce sellers, and small businesses who need to trust the numbers without writing complex SQL.

records.name: Rudow
records.tagline: Chat with your logs — observability that answers back.
records.description: Ask production what broke. Rudow is AI-native log observability without the dashboard tax: ship logs from Node or Python in ~30 seconds, then ask plain-English questions and get the root cause, with evidence. Flat pricing with a permanent free tier (20K logs/mo, AI chat, no credit card). Read-only by design — it reads a copy of your logs, never touches your tools. Native MCP server — Claude Code, Cursor, Cline, or any MCP client. 1 in 4 AI agents runs unmonitored (New Relic, Sep 2026).

records.name: LiveMaply
records.tagline: Live visitors, traffic insights, real connections.
records.description: LiveMaply helps website owners see who is visiting in real time, understand their traffic, and connect with visitors through live chat. It combines a live visitor map, traffic statistics, investigation tools, and optional Cloudflare integration in one platform. Built for creators, small businesses, and agencies, LiveMaply makes website activity easier to understand and manage.

records.name: BANA. — Ne lazım? BANA söyle.
records.tagline: Türkiye'nin yeni nesil işletme ve alışveriş platformu
records.description: BANA, kullanıcılarla işletmeleri tek platformda buluşturan yeni nesil bir dijital pazaryeridir. Alışverişten yemeğe, emlaktan araca, güzellikten seyahate ve yerel hizmetlere kadar farklı sektörleri tek çatı altında toplar. Kullanıcılar ihtiyaç duydukları ürün, hizmet ve işletmeleri şehir ve ilçelerine göre keşfedebilir; işletmeler ise kendi profilleriyle ürün ve hizmetlerini doğrudan müşterilere ulaştırabilir. BANA, Türkiye’de keşfetmenin ve ulaşmanın daha kolay bir yolunu sunar.

records.name: Tellura
records.tagline: Read and publish serialized fiction, ad-free
records.description: Tellura is a home for serialized fiction: publish chapter by chapter, read volume by volume. No ads, no algorithmic feed, no infinite scroll. The reader is built for long sittings: four themes, five typefaces, paginated or scrolling. Every novel is reviewed by a human moderator. Authors keep their copyright, write in Markdown, and schedule chapters. Free to read; coins are optional and go to the authors. Reader access is open for Product Hunt today; readers and author can apply for early access.

records.name: MailTag
records.tagline: Auto-labeled inbox your agents can safely act on
records.description: Meet Mailtag — inbox management built for the agent era. Describe how you want your emails categorized in plain English, and Mailtag automatically tags them. Clean up your inbox with bulk unsubscribe, subscription metrics, archiving, and more. For AI agents, Mailtag gives you an MCP with granular control over which emails, categories, time ranges, and even email content they can access. No more personal data sent to corporates without intent. Less inbox chaos. More control.

records.name: RexOne
records.tagline: Start from One, not Zero. Sovereign full-stack foundation
records.description: RexOne deletes 9 months of generic infrastructure slog from your roadmap. It is a sovereign, battle-hardened full-stack foundation spanning a Rails 8 API core, React 19 web client, and offline-first Flutter app. Instead of wrestling auth, Stripe webhooks, S3 uploads, and Web/Mobile contract drifts, RexOne gives builders an immutable, test-backed (1,690+ tests) baseline to launch production products in weeks. 100% free & open-source under Apache 2.0.

records.name: Dressmaker Guide
records.tagline: Play Dressmaker free in your browser, plus guides and mods
records.description: Dressmaker Guide is an unofficial fan hub for Dressmaker, the cozy dressmaking game that just launched on Steam. Other fan sites offer either the browser game or thin guides; this puts it all in one place: - Play the free Dressmaker prototype in your browser, no download - Guides to commissions, fabrics, cutting and sewing, each checked against the current game build - All 32 achievements with Steam unlock rates and a progress tracker - A curated mod directory with install help

records.name: Prefer
records.tagline: The execution layer for AEO
records.description: AEO should not be another dashboard. Prefer works at the execution layer, helping brands understand how ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity talk about them, identify where they are missing, and take action to improve their visibility. Turn AI search insights into action with autonomous agents. Less reporting. More doing.

records.name: frescosolutions
records.tagline: Petzen – Pet Shopify Theme is designed for online pet stores
records.description: Petzen – Pet Shopify Theme is a thoughtfully crafted solution designed for online pet stores, animal product retailers, and pet care brands that want a well-structured and visually appealing storefront. The Petzen - Pet Shopify Theme offers a clean layout that helps highlight pet products while maintaining a friendly look suited for pet-focused businesses. Store owners can easily present pet food, accessories, grooming items, toys, and other supplies in clearly organized sections.

records.name: Luxstyle Ai
records.tagline: Luxry life photo ai
records.description: Instantly transform your ordinary photos into images set in luxurious locations or featuring high-end cars using Luxstyle AI; you can also change your outfit and generate a fitter, more muscular version of yourself.

records.name: Munora
records.tagline: Your whole household, one clear number.
records.description: Local-first personal finance for your whole household — Windows, Android & iOS. Accounts, transactions, investments, loans, property, goal planning and multi-currency, with every figure kept on your own device. - ankitjha67/Munora

records.name: EmailManager
records.tagline: AI reply drafts inside Outlook — you review and send
records.description: EmailManager writes reply drafts for routine emails right inside Outlook, in your own tone. Built for busy German offices — property managers, tax advisors and brokers. Emails are processed in memory only, on servers in Germany, nothing is stored, GDPR-compliant. No auto-send, ever: you review, edit and send every draft. Connects to Microsoft 365 / Outlook instantly; Gmail / Google Workspace in beta on request; other providers not supported yet. Free: 50 emails, no credit card — then €19/month.

records.name: Cover the Gaps Community
records.tagline: English learners can correct each other. AI waits its turn.
records.description: Just opened: a members-only community for adults learning English. Post “Check my English” and members can correct it sentence by sentence; if nobody does in about 4 hours, a labelled AI helper suggests fixes. Accepted fixes go to your “My mistakes” journal.

records.name: Photoshop Generative Fill
records.tagline: AI-Powered Textile Design for Modern Designers
records.description: Photoshop Generative Fill helps textile designers turn ideas and reference artwork into clean, production-ready digital textile designs. It simplifies design creation, refinement, color variations, pattern development, and print preparation, helping designers reduce manual work and move from concept to finished artwork faster. Built for textile designers, print studios, and creative professionals.

records.name: Notes2Me Mobile
records.tagline: Seamless Cross-Device Share between iOS devices and Macs
records.description: Notes2Me Mobile is a powerful iOS companion app for iPhone and iPad designed to seamlessly exchange messages and files across all your personal devices—including your Mac—using your iCloud account. Working in perfect harmony with its desktop counterpart, Notes2Me, the app requires zero configuration, no bluetooth and no secondary logins: if you are signed into iCloud, you are ready to go.

records.name: FoundName
records.tagline: Find a great app name that's actually still free
records.description: Describe your app idea and get creative, brandable name ideas. Each name is checked live on the App Store, Google Play and domains (.com,io,app and more), with a sound score, so you only fall for names you can actually use. Then sketch your first logo, colors and brand brief on a canvas. Free to try, no signup needed.

records.name: ListenSlice
records.tagline: Turn English audio into sentence-by-sentence practice
records.description: Practise English listening one sentence at a time. Choose a library passage or bring your own audio, replay difficult parts, type what you hear, and compare with the transcript. Save your place and continue later. Free and paid features available.

records.name: AnúncioIA
records.tagline: AI-powered ads for sellers, optimized for every platform
records.description: AnúncioIA helps online sellers create and adapt sales-ready ads for Instagram, TikTok, WhatsApp, Facebook, Shopee, and online stores. Describe your product once and get platform-specific content ready to use.

records.name: Wiring Atlas
records.tagline: Job management for electricians, built on building maps
records.description: Job management for electrical contractors. Map each building once: rooms, panels, and circuits. Then plan jobs, print customer approval reports, and hand your crew clear job sheets. Each job's history stays with the building for the next visit.

records.name: CardKit
records.tagline: Self-hosted digital business cards as a PWA
records.description: Self-hosted PWA for personal digital business cards. Share by link or QR, export vCard, add to iPhone Home Screen. One Docker image; your data stays on your NAS or VPS.

records.name: Launch of Trumpsignaltracker
records.tagline: I built a platform to empower retail traders.
records.description: With TST, you can, - Track Donald Trump’s social media posts on X and Truth Social for alerts via email, Discord, or Telegram, and even filter for only keywords - Get transcriptions for any videos he posts - AI insights linking any mention of CEOs of companies within a post with context - Automatically classifies any AI slop he posts, so you can get the real data

records.name: Industrial dust masks
records.tagline: Keep dust out, keep protection in
records.description: Industrial dust masks are personal protective equipment designed to help protect the respiratory system from dust, smoke, bacteria, and certain harmful airborne particles in the workplace. They are commonly used in industries such as manufacturing, construction, chemical processing, metallurgy, cement, electronics, pharmaceuticals, and cleanrooms. Join Thien Bang to learn more about this type of mask!

records.name: Gigs and SHT, LLC
records.tagline: Small business - client management tool
records.description: My Gigs apps: Task management apps. Download or use your browser to boost your efficiency! Key new features include Reports functions: Client List, Income and Cash Flow Statements (periodic accounting reports). Get it on Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.gigsandsht.mygigs6&hl=en_US. Get it on Apple/iOS: jobs.mygigsandsht.com

records.name: BoozeBrawl
records.tagline: Free party drinking games you play on your phones
records.description: Free drinking games and party games in your browser. One person hosts, friends join with a code, and the games run themselves: fill-in-the-blank, a drawing game, trivia and more. Play in one room, on a TV or over a video call. No download, no account. 21+.

records.name: ManageBloc
records.tagline: Manage clients, projects, tasks, invoices in one space.
records.description: ManageBloc brings clients, projects, jobs, tasks, calendar, time, expenses, and invoicing into one organized workspace. Add work to your calendar, track time, and turn it directly into an invoice - without creating a report first or entering the same work twice. Every project stays connected to its client, keeping tasks, time and billing organized. Get reminders across devices, install ManageBloc as a web app, and spend less time jumping between disconnected tools.

records.name: Social By Valkence - Interest-Based
records.tagline: Where the internet connects around what matters.
records.description: Connect with your people and discover communities that matter. Be among the first to find your people. Join the waitlist to get early access. Experience a new way for the internet to connect around shared interests. This platform aims to foster meaningful connections by bringing people together based on what truly matters to them. Sign up for the waitlist to be one of the first to experience this innovative social networking space.

records.name: Refill
records.tagline: Every seat in the office is hard. Rehearse yours first.
records.description: As a new hire, your boss feels impossible. As a senior, the new hire does. As a lead, it's the whole team. Refill lets you write the coworkers you're struggling with and roleplay with them, no stakes and no judgment, until the real office feels lighter. (Available in the US, Canada and Australia)

records.name: Lipi: Your AI companion
records.tagline: Track, Switch, Reuse, Fork & Handoff: for Claude.ai
records.description: Lipi shows your Claude usage right where you chat. See your 5-hour and weekly limits live, get an alert before you hit them, and see roughly how many messages you have left. It also exports any chat with its artifacts, keeps a searchable history of your prompts with 600+ ready-made templates, and switches between Claude accounts in one click. It runs in your browser and talks only to claude.ai: no tracking, no servers of ours.

records.name: Bardiyah
records.tagline: From idea to script to publish, built for content creators
records.description: Bardiyah is a free workspace built for content creators from day one. Capture ideas, write video scripts as cards, read them on a teleprompter inside the app, and track every video from idea to publish. Works with ChatGPT and Claude through MCP.

records.name: rugsandriches.com
records.tagline: Bespoke Rugs, Timeless Craftsmanship
records.description: Discover timeless, custom-designed rugs by Rugs & Riches. Combining three generations of craftsmanship with complete in-house production for global brands.

records.name: CyberPub
records.tagline: An ephemeral 1:1 anonymous chat in a cyberpunk bar
records.description: CyberPub is a temporary, anonymous 1:1 web chat styled like a cyberpunk bar. Step in, grab a private table for two, chat, and once you leave, the conversation vanishes without a trace. No public profiles, no history, and no permanent message database. Powered by Supabase and Web Crypto API, it features a rolling buffer of the last 10 messages, sector rooms, and an immersive sci-fi vibe.

records.name: Spoondle
records.tagline: A new daily word puzzle game, inspired by spoonerisms.
records.description: A daily word game: pair two words, swap one letter, and uncover a new word or phrase. It can be tricky, but you'll get it spooner or later! Includes a free archive of past puzzles, statistics, multiple themes and customization options, a guided tutorial intro, and more. Optimized for both web and mobile. Feedback? Ideas? Reach out: hey@spoondle.app

records.name: Tempo Kit 2.0
records.tagline: Your music practice workspace, right in the browser. Widgets
records.description: Turn your browser into a music practice workspace. Keep your metronome, tuner, drone, recorder, notes and video controls beside the music you're learning, with a journal that logs practice automatically. New in 2.0: customizable widgets, a full-tab Dashboard, Pomodoro, a reps counter, sheet music in presets, new tuner views for intonation practice, and more. Save your setup and pick up where you left off. Free core tools; Pro for more.

records.name: Blost
records.tagline: Your blog, on autopilot — AI writes & publishes daily
records.description: Blost is an AI SEO autopilot: one article, every day, always about your business, always on your site — on any website, any platform. It learns your brand voice, builds a keyword-driven content calendar from real search opportunity, then writes and publishes a fully optimized article every morning to your own Blost-hosted blog. WordPress and UNAS sites get native auto-publishing too. Once live, it connects to Google Search Console to track real results and keeps getting smarter.

records.name: Tripnic
records.tagline: Plan, book & split trip costs with your group - No choas
records.description: Tripnic is the all-in-one AI travel companion for group trips. It builds a shared itinerary, syncs and price-compares bookings across OTA platforms, splits expenses automatically, and keeps everything — real-time flight/train tracking, group chat, photo sharing, a document vault, currency conversion, even gamified trip challenges — in one shared plan. No more juggling ten apps and a WhatsApp thread.

records.name: GeoAlbum: Sort Photos by Place
records.tagline: Sort Photos by Where Taken
records.description: GeoAlbum organizes photos by where they were taken. Save a place and radius, choose an Apple Photos album, review matching photos, and add your selections in a batch. Create places from the map, an address or place search, or a photo’s recorded location. Saved rules can be reused, and photos already in the destination album are skipped.

records.name: CreatePie
records.tagline: Courses, coaching and webinars. Zero sales commission.
records.description: CreatePie helps creators publish free or paid courses, schedule 1:1 sessions and run webinars. Connect your own eligible Stripe, Razorpay or Dodo account with zero CreatePie sales commission. Courses is $19/month or $199/year; Complete is $29/month or $299/year. Live attendees get private waiting-room credentials and a reminder 30 minutes before the session. Start with a free course.

records.name: Threadwarm
records.tagline: Find Reddit threads asking for what you sell
records.description: Threadwarm finds Reddit threads where people ask for what you sell, scores them by buying intent, and drafts a reply in your voice that follows each subreddit's rules. You approve every reply and post it from your own account. It never posts for you and never asks for your Reddit password. Free plan: 5 subreddits, 40 AI credits a month. Paid from $29/month.

records.name: Royalsproperties.In
records.tagline: Ghaziabad and Delhi NCR with royalsproperties.in.
records.description: Explore residential and commercial properties in prime locations across Ghaziabad and Delhi NCR with royalsproperties.in. Find flats, apartments, villas, plots, and commercial spaces with verified property details, suitable for living, business, and investment.

records.name: DiaperPrice
records.tagline: Compare diaper prices and find the lowest cost per diaper
records.description: DiaperPrice compares current diaper offers by cost per diaper, so pack sizes are easier to compare. Choose a brand, size, or type, browse tracked products, and see the lowest available offers. It also includes practical guides and a diaper cost calculator. Free to use; retailer links may earn a commission.

records.name: SignDesk
records.tagline: Your real signature on PDF, Word & Excel — 100% offline
records.description: Photograph your signature once — SignDesk removes the paper and shadows, straightens it and keeps the natural ink. Then place it on PDF, Word or Excel files in seconds: move, resize, rotate, add dates and initials on every page. Each signature varies slightly, like a real pen. Everything stays on your PC: 100% offline, encrypted with your password, with an audit log of every signed file. 8 languages. Windows 10/11. 14-day free trial, one-time license.

records.name: ShiftCast
records.tagline: Real-time stream delay for streamers. One click, no cuts.
records.description: ShiftCast adds or removes delay on your live stream in one click, without ever cutting it. Protect yourself from stream sniping, spoilers and private info showing on screen. OBS sets itself up automatically, and one stream goes to Twitch, YouTube, Kick, TikTok, Restream, Facebook or any RTMP server at once. Delay from 0 to 120 s (rewind or freeze), hotkeys and Stream Deck support, zero dropped frames. Windows 10/11 · €4.99 one-time, lifetime license.

records.name: Cross Stitch Pattern Creator
records.tagline: Turn any photo into a printable cross stitch pattern.
records.description: Turn a photo of your pet, your family or a favorite place into a cross stitch pattern, right in your browser. Every color is matched to a real DMC floss, and the printable PDF has a symbol chart, a thread key and how many skeins to buy. Patterns up to 60 × 60 stitches are free with no sign-up; larger ones are $3.99 once, no subscription. Fix single stitches in the editor, spell names in stitch alphabets, or grab a free ready-made pattern.

records.name: babuba | %100 EV & Listing Platform
records.tagline: Every EV, every spec, one place.
records.description: babuba is an electric vehicle platform. Marketplace: new car catalogue and used listings on the same page, so you can compare a model's price against its second-hand market. Data: range, consumption, battery capacity and chemistry, charging times, voltage, warranty, structured fields on every vehicle record, not free text in a description. Tools: charging map with route planning, model comparison, price evaluation. Financing, insurance, inspection and assistance are next. Web, iOS, Android.

records.name: shoud.online
records.tagline: Your full AI C-suite — scale to ₹1Cr+.
records.description: We built shoud.online as a routed AI C-suite, not another chatbot. One Chief reads your question and sends it to the right executive — CEO, CFO, CTO, CISO, Chief AI, 100+ roles. Brief your team once; every executive shares the memory. Every reply shows live reasoning, clickable sources, Python math, token and rupee cost. No subscriptions. One-time from ₹2,999. It helps any company scale to ₹1Cr+ in revenue.

records.name: SyncPage
records.tagline: Real-time doc collaboration, zero sign-up for guests
records.description: SyncPage is a real-time document collaboration workspace for online meetings, shared reviews, and focused decisions. Upload a PDF, PowerPoint, Word, or Excel file, share a space, and work together live: present page by page, annotate in real time, and talk by voice — with the document at the center instead of a blurry screen share. Guests join free with just a name. No sign-up, no login, no payment — send a link or a 6-digit Space Code and they're in. Try it: https://syncpage.app

records.name: PF Terminal
records.tagline: A private, local-first crypto portfolio terminal
records.description: PF Terminal is a native, local-first crypto portfolio tracker for Apple devices. Track multiple portfolios, follow live Binance and Bybit prices, analyze P&L and allocation, monitor stablecoins and peg status, search 1,000 assets offline, and choose price sources per asset. Optional private iCloud sync. No account, no custody, no tracking. Free and open source on macOS.

records.name: Gatling.chat
records.tagline: The Turbo Messenger for LinkedIn
records.description: The turbo messenger for LinkedIn: split inboxes, follow-up reminders, manual-send sequences, and keyboard-first triage. No automated sending.

records.name: Distrove
records.tagline: Your AI growth and distribution team, built for founders.
records.description: Introducing Distrove ! You’ve built something worth selling whether it's a SaaS, local business, mobile app, or service agency. Distrove helps you get it in front of the right people. Add your website and your AI team researches your market and competitors, identifies promising channels, and prepares campaigns, content, and outreach tailored to your business. Keep your strategy, prospects, and results in one workspace, so you spend less time figuring out distribution and more time growing.

records.name: ABC
records.tagline: ABC
records.description: Watch the ABC Shows online at abc.com. Get exclusive videos and free episodes.

records.name: Tweet Media Archive
records.tagline: Easier downloads from social media
records.description: Download videos, photos, GIFs and carousels from supported social posts. Paste a link, preview the media and save it. Use the browser extension or Cloud to save to your device, Google Drive or Dropbox.

records.name: Glance

Import your product catalogue, embed a small widget, and get faceted results, synonyms, promotional banners, pinned and excluded results, and analytics that show what people search for and don't find. Available in English and German, with plugins for Shopify, Shopware, JTL and WordPress.

records.name: Wandrio.net
records.tagline: Collect the world - one tile at a time - Tile hunting game
records.description: Explore the world one tile at a time! Wandrio is a movement-powered adventure and exploration game where you collect tiles on the map by walking, running, or cycling. Conquer new areas, become a legend, and challenge your friends to join the quest. Every step expands your map. Turn your everyday life into an adventure and explore places you didn't know you wanted to go, or didn't want to go.

records.name: X sync
records.tagline: You won't miss any X links collected by you ever again
records.description: X-sync help to sync/organize your X.com bookmarks and likes locally into one place. You can mark any tag to local tweet, search, sort or filter them and export result collection as markdown file into Obsidian.

records.name: Clariti
records.tagline: Introducing Clariti-Autonomous QA for modern software teams.
records.description: Clariti tests your product the way a human QA does — visually and autonomously. It asks questions, listens when you guide it, and remembers what it learns, so it gets smarter with every run. A good QA engineer doesn’t test by reading selectors or scripts. They open the product, use it, look at what’s happening, and figure out what broke. That’s the thesis I started building Clariti around: 𝗖𝗮𝗻 𝘄𝗲 𝗯𝘂𝗶𝗹𝗱 𝘀𝗼𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗵𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗲𝘀𝘁𝘀 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝘄𝗮𝘆 𝗮 𝗵𝘂𝗺𝗮𝗻 𝗤𝗔 𝗱𝗼𝗲𝘀?

records.name: RouteFlick
records.tagline: Turn your journeys into cinematic 3D map videos
records.description: RouteFlick makes the journey the story on a 3D globe. Add stops, start from a template, or import a Google Maps link or GPX route (Pro). Choose flights, helicopters, driving, buses, trains, boats, cycling or walking; road, rail and sea legs can follow routed paths. Customize map looks, camera motion, vehicles, photos and music; preview, then render an MP4 on your own device in vertical, square or landscape. Start free with HD exports; Pro adds watermark-free 4K at 60 fps.

records.name: Voltage Drop Calculator
records.tagline: Calculate Voltage Drop Instantly
records.description: Free voltage drop calculator for copper and aluminum wire, AC/DC, single- and three-phase circuits. Get instant NEC-based results and the formula.

records.name: ConvertAny
records.tagline: Free online file conversion and app icon generation
records.description: ConvertAny converts documents, images, audio, video and ebooks in your browser. Upload a file, choose an output format and download the result without installing separate software. It also generates app icon sets for iOS, Android and macOS. The free web tool brings common conversion tasks into one place for people working across different file types.

records.name: Everbecome · Daily Practice
records.tagline: Become who you keep saying you will.
records.description: Everbecome is a behavior-change platform for people who want to turn intention into practice. With Everbecome, you can: • Practice meaningful changes in everyday life • Check in consistently without pressure or streak obsession • Reflect on wins, struggles, and what you’re learning • Join small pods for accountability and support • Witness the progress of others and be witnessed in return A daily practice, witnessed.

records.name: GB SMS Gateway
records.tagline: SMS Gateway
records.description: GB SMS Gateway is a complete system for managing and monitoring SMS messages received and sent through Yeastar TG* GSM gateways. It provides real-time message viewing, automatic email forwarding rules, and user management with local, LDAP/Active Directory, and SSO authentication.

records.name: aetrivo.com
records.tagline: Minimal digital planner to organize your business backend
records.description: A minimal, professionally structured digital planner designed to organize your business backend. Streamline daily tasks, track key goals, and maintain complete operational clarity—all in one place.

records.name: SETL: Focus on Life by Less Screen Time
records.tagline: Reduces your daily screentime by 4h 3m by blocking ios apps
records.description: Over 2.2B iPhones were sold in the last 10yrs. The average online adult spends 6h38m online every day! Enough, at that pace, to LOSE 20+ years of an 80-year life! YOU already know you should stop scrolling. The hardest part is stopping, and SETL solves that. It automatically blocks the apps your willpower can't. Users cut screen time by 4h3m a day on average. 3h during the day and 1h3m in the evening. Use SETL to focus & go to bed in peace. Focus on your own life, not everyone else’s online...

records.name: NursingJobsUS
records.tagline: Dedicated job platform for US travel nurses&healthcare pros
records.description: TravelNursingJobsUS is a specialized job board for travel nurses and healthcare professionals in the US. Browse high-paying assignments, filter by state or clinical specialty, and apply directly to top healthcare agencies and hospitals.

records.name: Height Comparer
records.tagline: Compare heights visually in cm and feet
records.description: A focused visual height comparison tool for people and characters. Add multiple subjects, edit names, heights, silhouettes and colors, switch between centimeters and feet/inches, and compare everyone on one measured baseline.

records.name: MJGrow IT
records.tagline: Free AI prompts for images, video & marketing
records.description: MJGrow IT is a free AI prompt library for creators, marketers and eCommerce businesses. Explore ready-to-use prompts for AI images, product advertising, video generation and creative workflows. Copy a prompt, customize it for your project, and turn simple ideas into professional content.

records.name: Aurie
records.tagline: Your links, from everyone, in one place.
records.description: Specs, docs, and tickets arrive as links, across too many channels to keep track of. Keep the ones that matter together. Aurie companion on every page you visit. The Aurie browser extension keeps saving close at hand. Keep the page, file it later.

records.name: Vibote
records.tagline: Your remote. Your flow.
records.description: Vibote turns your Bluetooth TV remote into a macOS coding controller. Map buttons to shortcuts, hold to talk, and use your favorite AI voice app. Free and open source.

records.name: BreakEven
records.tagline: Know the moment a flat fee job stops paying you fairly
records.description: BreakEven runs inside DaVinci Resolve and shows your real hourly rate live while you edit a flat fee job, warns you at 80% of the fee, then turns red past break even with the exact overage in dollars. Mac + Windows.

records.name: ShowcaseMe
records.tagline: Turn your work into a shareable portfolio in seconds
records.description: A personalized portfolio website for coders, video editors, and thumbnail designers. Sign in with Google and your profile auto-builds in minutes, just add your skills and projects. Get a shareable link to send clients, who can view your work and leave star ratings and reviews, shown as your Client Satisfaction and Quality Score for instant credibility. Add a custom logo, edit anytime. Completely free.

records.name: SnappyCalc
records.tagline: Free online web based tool regarding, Finance , Maths, etc
records.description: SnappyCalc is a free online web platform that provides a diverse suite of digital calculators to simplify daily math, financial planning, and lifestyle tracking.

records.name: Tryda
records.tagline: Rate outfits, get style feedback, and try on clothes
records.description: Tryda.ai is your AI personal stylist that helps you discover your best style. Try on outfits virtually, get honest style feedback, and find what truly looks good on you.

records.name: TWB Laundry
records.tagline: Hotel Laundry Services You Can Trust | TWB Laundry
records.description: TWB Laundry - Where Quality Meets Cleanliness. Peterborough's Most Advanced Laundry Solution with 20 years of experience.

records.name: AasPaas
records.tagline: Explore cities through locals — not star ratings.
records.description: AasPaas helps you experience a city through locals — not tourist checklists. Browse vibe and community notes, ask tiny location-specific questions grounded in real tips, then hit Make a Plan for an itinerary that matches your time and mood. Built for travelers who want stories over star ratings. First AI plan is free; unlock more with Trip Pass, Travel Year, or Lifetime.

records.name: Manny Wenas Featured Slider
records.tagline: Lightweight, vanilla JS Gutenberg slider for WordPress
records.description: After heavy slider plugins threw 500 errors and slowed down my site, I built a zero-dependency alternative. Manny Wenas Featured Slider delivers a full-width hero post slider with thumbnail strip navigation, native Gutenberg block controls, and category filtering—built purely with Vanilla JS for maximum page speed.

records.name: Webdesly Appointments
records.tagline: Book sessions with mentors, coaches, and consultants.
records.description: Book online appointments with mentors, coaches, and consultants. Free accounts, no in-app payments — Webdesly Appointments.

records.name: Digi Zilla Pro
records.tagline: AI-powered cloud hosting, domains with 0% renewal hikes
records.description: DigiZilla Pro is a transparent cloud hosting and domain platform featuring a Same Renewal Price Guarantee (0% renewal markups), free lifetime WHOIS privacy, LiteSpeed NVMe WordPress hosting, 1-click DMail SPF/DKIM auto-fixing, and a 24/7 autonomous multi-lingual AI cloud engineer.

records.name: Youtube Transcripts
records.tagline: Free YouTube transcript generator: any language, 5 formats
records.description: Paste a YouTube link and get the full transcript in about ten seconds. One fetch returns every subtitle track the video has, human-written and auto-generated, so switching language is instant. Read it with clickable timestamps or as clean paragraphs, search inside it, copy it as a ready-made AI prompt, or download TXT, SRT, VTT, CSV or JSON. Free, no account, no watermark. The optional Chrome extension adds AI summaries and chat beside the player.

records.name: ReleaseDelta
records.tagline: AI API changes matched to your stack.
records.description: ReleaseDelta tracks official AI model, API, and SDK changes and matches them to your declared stack. Get source evidence, deadlines, and next steps. Browse the public deprecation calendar without signing up, or start free with one monitored stack and a weekly brief. No provider API keys or repository access required.

records.name: IVO.md
records.tagline: Moldova’s marketplace for fast, local shopping
records.description: IVO.md is a marketplace built for Moldova, connecting customers with products from local and international merchants in one multilingual shopping experience. Shop on web, iOS or Android, pay online, and get delivery organized through IVO. For merchants, there are no listing or monthly fees—they pay only when they sell. Behind the scenes, IVO handles catalog normalization, multilingual content, payments, order management and delivery.

records.name: Gorilla Panel
records.tagline: Client portal + Chrome widget for website support requests
records.description: Gorilla Panel is a client portal and help desk for companies running business-critical websites and stores. Clients see tasks, hours used, reports, invoices and documents in one dashboard, synced two-way with ClickUp. GP Connect, our Chrome extension, lets clients click any element on their site to report a change or bug: screenshot, browser data and console errors attached, instant estimate, in-browser payment. White-label ready for agencies.

records.name: Cutroom
records.tagline: Remove ums and pauses from talking videos on iPhone
records.description: Cutroom finds pauses and filler words in talking videos, then lets you review every cut. It cleans phone audio and adds captions that stay in sync. Editing and export run on your iPhone, without uploading your clips.

records.name: Triton Relay
records.tagline: AI that turns your Facebook & Instagram DMs into leads
records.description: Triton Relay is an AI-native Facebook and Instagram DM automation platform. Connect your Pages and let a conversational bot answer, qualify, and route the leads your ads generate.

records.name: Tudoom
records.tagline: Social app for chat, communities, live rooms and calls
records.description: Tudoom brings chat, communities, live rooms, voice and video calls into one social platform. Meet people, join conversations, discover communities and connect in real time. Built to give people more ways to communicate, participate and build connections beyond traditional social feeds.

records.name: AIforms
records.tagline: Drop-in form endpoints & simple CRM for AI vibe coders
records.description: AIforms is the "Stripe for CRMs"—built for modern devs & AI vibe coders. Drop a single endpoint URL into any website built with v0, Bolt, Cursor, or React, and instantly capture and manage leads with zero backend code. Why it stands out: • Vibe Coding Ready: 1-line drop-in URL for any AI-generated frontend. • Instant Zero-Setup CRM: Submissions automatically become structured lead entries. • AI Form Builder: Prompt-to-published forms in seconds. • Full Pipeline: Webhooks, spam filters, & alerts.

records.name: RootsLore
records.tagline: Build a family tree and see its story unfold on a map
records.description: RootsLore combines a family tree with a time-lapse map. Add relatives, life events and places, then play how family stories move across generations. Start without signing up, keep a tree private, and share it with family by link. Web and mobile apps are available.

records.name: WoadLeyef
records.tagline: Opinion → Advice → Complain → Settle.
records.description: WoadLeyef — share opinions, get advice, settle arguments and air complaints.

records.name: Toolkitta
records.tagline: Private file tools that run in your browser
records.description: Toolkitta is a free toolbox of image, PDF, audio, video and text tools that run entirely in your browser. Compress PDFs, convert iPhone HEIC photos, trim and compress videos, sign and merge PDFs, format JSON, and chain steps into workflows (one video in, a smaller MP4, its MP3 and a numbered PDF out). Your files never leave your device: no uploads, no signup, no watermarks.

records.name: k8sight
records.tagline: A free, open-source desktop UI for Kubernetes
records.description: k8sight is a native desktop app for any cluster in your kubeconfig: live dashboard, logs, a pod shell, topology, Helm, Argo CD, a Trivy-powered Security Center and cost views. EKS, AKS and GKE need no CLI. Free, open source, with a no-cluster demo.

records.name: OpenGraph+ for Mac
records.tagline: Preview & debug Open Graph for any website, even localhost
records.description: Most Open Graph checkers need a crawler to fetch your page, so they can't see localhost. OpenGraph+ for Mac can. Point it at localhost, staging, or any website and see the link card 22 platforms will show. Inspect the tags and copy what's missing. Free. No account.

records.name: Sparta
records.tagline: The frontier of agent verification. Prove what changed.
records.description: AI agents now issue refunds and move money, but top models get irreversible actions right only about 56% of the time. Worlds lets you test your agent locally in exact replicas of Stripe, Zendesk, and Salesforce. Describe a scenario in plain English, inject failures like an expired API key, and fast-forward time to catch delayed mistakes. Every run is graded on real state, is deterministic, and fits your CI/CD: one command, no SDK, free today. Feel free to find us here: usesparta.co

records.name: WoluTools
records.tagline: 190 file and data tools that each do one job well
records.description: Each tool does one job and states its limits up front. The ones people use most: compress a PDF or image to an exact size (2 MB, 500 KB, any limit), read DMARC aggregate reports without forwarding them anywhere, check a Google Merchant feed or Shopify CSV before import, compare two supplier price lists, and developer checks (JWT, regex, cron, CSP, Unix time) that run in your browser. 37 tools are free with no limit; 115 more give 3 free jobs a day, 44 of them without an account.

records.name: TH Blogs
records.tagline: blog
records.description: TH Blogs menghadirkan artikel, panduan, dan insight terbaru seputar teknologi, AI, bisnis, lifestyle, dan berbagai topik menarik lainnya.

records.name: GeeksCharter
records.tagline: GeeksCharter — the AI-native Hiring OS for tech talent.
records.description: Crafting Hiring for your business needs...
